name: dsos
description: Devil's Sunrise Operating System — an AI + cybersecurity workbench themed as a fake OS

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c red,yellow "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c red,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run electron:wait"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
